Hitar Settings

Configure translation backends, caching, site rules, and privacy preferences.

Recommended for Production: Docker Self-Hosting

Public instances are rate-limited. Run your own private, key-less LibreTranslate instance locally or on your server in 1 second:

docker run -p 5000:5000 libretranslate/libretranslate

Translation Endpoints & Failover

Endpoints are tried in order. If the primary rate-limits, Hitar automatically falls back to the next.

Always Translate Domains

Pages on these domains automatically translate upon load.

Never Translate Domains

Translation is disabled on these domains.

Cache & Batch Tuning

IndexedDB Translation Cache
0 / 20,000 entries

LRU eviction automatically purges oldest entries when capacity is reached.

2000 chars

Controls maximum characters sent per translation HTTP request.
